info.title: StreamCore IPTV Backend API
info.description: OpenAPI specification generated from the Axum routing graph in backend/src/lib.rs and nested handler routers (updated for v1.2.0). Authentication is either JWT (Authorization: Bearer <token> or iptv_auth_token cookie) or X-Master-API-Key for protected endpoints. Public API v1 uses X-API-Key.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token (Authorization: Bearer <token>). Backend also accepts iptv_auth_token cookie for browser/media requests.

MasterApiKey.name: X-Master-API-Key
MasterApiKey.description: Master API key that bypasses normal auth (admin context).

ResellerApiKey.name: X-API-Key
ResellerApiKey.description: Reseller API key used by Public API v1 endpoints (/api/v1/*).

channel_ids.description: Comma-separated list of content channel IDs

path.description: Local filesystem path to the uploaded file

get.summary: Get content with seasons for editing

200.description: Always returns success message to prevent email enumeration

400.description: Email service not configured / bad request

get.summary: Get content delivery details (decrypted stream URL)

403.description: Demo creation disabled or IP banned
